title: 奖励最顶尖的 K 名学生
summary: 报告中每个正面词得三分、负面词扣一分，按总分降序且学号升序选出前 k 名学生。
insight: 把正负词分别放入哈希集合，逐报告按空格分词累加得分，再排序 [score 降序,id 升序]。
pitfalls: 报告与 student_id 按相同下标对应
未出现在词表中的词得零分

solutions.title: 哈希集合评分后排序
solutions.idea: 构造学生 [score,id] 列表并按题意排序。
steps: 遍历每份 report 的 words，正面加三、负面减一
按 score 降序、id 升序排序
取前 k 个 id 返回

complexity.time: O(total report characters + n log n)

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> topStudents(String[] positiveFeedback,String[] negativeFeedback,String[] report,int[] studentId,int k){Set<String> positive=new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(positiveFeedback)),negative=new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(negativeFeedback));List<int[]> students=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<report.length;i++){int score=0;for(String word:report[i].split(" ")){if(positive.contains(word))score+=3;if(negative.contains(word))score--;}students.add(new int[]{score,studentId[i]});}students.sort((a,b)->a[0]!=b[0]?Integer.compare(b[0],a[0]):Integer.compare(a[1],b[1]));List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<k;i++)answer.add(students.get(i)[1]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun topStudents(positiveFeedback:Array<String>,negativeFeedback:Array<String>,report:Array<String>,studentId:IntArray,k:Int):List<Int>{val positive=positiveFeedback.toHashSet();val negative=negativeFeedback.toHashSet();val students=report.indices.map{i->var score=0;for(word in report[i].split(" ")){if(word in positive)score+=3;if(word in negative)score--};intArrayOf(score,studentId[i])}.sortedWith(compareByDescending<IntArray>{it[0]}.thenBy{it[1]});return students.take(k).map{it[1]}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> topStudents(vector<string>& positiveFeedback,vector<string>& negativeFeedback,vector<string>& report,vector<int>& studentId,int k){unordered_set<string> positive(positiveFeedback.begin(),positiveFeedback.end()),negative(negativeFeedback.begin(),negativeFeedback.end());vector<pair<int,int>> students;for(int i=0;i<(int)report.size();++i){stringstream stream(report[i]);string word;int score=0;while(stream>>word){if(positive.count(word))score+=3;if(negative.count(word))--score;}students.push_back({-score,studentId[i]});}sort(students.begin(),students.end());vector<int> answer;for(int i=0;i<k;++i)answer.push_back(students[i].second);return answer;} };
